title: Borrow — first-loan illustration motion
summary: Three illustration and motion directions for the first-loan intro on Borrow. Each plays once when the intro scrolls into view; reduced motion shows the final frame. Replay sits under each card.

sections.title: Options in the intro
sections.note: Compact intro size, as shipped. Before shows the current illustration.

frames.label: A — Keep & draw
frames.note: USDC slides out from behind the coins you keep: borrowing without selling.

frames.label: B — Counterweight
frames.note: Collateral drops onto the beam and outweighs the loan: the buffer made physical.

frames.label: C — Tether
frames.note: USDC lifts off and a line ties it back to your coins: the loan stays linked to collateral.

sections.title: Final frames
sections.note: Resting state at intro and larger sizes, light and dark.

sections.title: Reduced motion
sections.note: No movement; the final frame renders immediately.
